page_hint: Ch 20 §3 "Autoscaling economics"; dependent anchors in Ch 21 §3, Ch 22 §6, Ch 23 §3, Ch 25 §3 and §6

Cost on the governing fleet: (23 × $20 + $40) / 144,000 = $3.47 per 1K, not $3.19 — a 9% understatement of the peak cost per 1K. Break-even against a 23-host static fleet ($460/hr) moves from 19 hosts / ~37.6 rps to 21 hosts / ~41.5 rps. Dependent anchors: Ch 21 §3 ("216,000 × $24.97/1K ≈ $5,394" and "216,000 × ~$14.038/1K ≈ $3,032") inherit the 21-host self-host monthly cost (21 × ~$7.4K = ~$155.4K, the stated $155.8K); Ch 22 §6 ADR 0015 ("~$155.8K/mo (~$24.97/1K) self-host"); Ch 23 §3 ("a ~21–32-host fleet at the canonical peak"); Ch 25 §3 ADR 0016 Context ("the canonical fleet is 21 hosts at peak"); Ch 25 §6 ADR 0015 R1 and Consequences ("21-host KV-screen headline / 32-host N−1 policy").
